0022600102.text: The LA Clippers (1-0), first in the Pacific and first in the West, visit the Los Angeles Lakers (1-0), who sit second in the Pacific and fifth in the West. The Clippers will be without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Clippers' most recent meeting was a 125-122 loss to the Lakers in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026.
